request: Restrict the COPS headless entry point to offline defensive work, refresh its public metadata, and verify Detection Quality chat resume.
scope: The offline operation catalog, standalone CLI and MCP adapters, private run state, and regression coverage for the existing workspace chat entry point.
setup: Use the dedicated issue 334 worktree with repository dependencies and the optional MCP SDK for conformance tests.
constraints: The headless surface operates on supplied data, leaves worker-backed records intact, and grants no execution authority. The required review and merge gates remain in force.

steps.action: Bind discovery, validation, and dispatch to the published offline operations and regenerate per-package metadata.

verify.expected: The checked-in schemas and catalogs match the offline bindings.

steps.action: Persist offline receipts in the private runtime and refuse prototype worker records and configuration.

verify.expected: An offline run survives restart and worker input cannot advance any state.

steps.action: Exercise the CLI, MCP and workspace Copilot entry points under the headless conformance job.

verify.expected: The standalone adapters pass and the chat harness reuses its completed suite after interruption.

acceptance.given: An offline defensive request supplies its input as JSON.
acceptance.when: Invoke the work request through the CLI and service.
acceptance.then: Both return equivalent structured results and redact rejected input.

acceptance.entrypoint: cops tools invoke with a private runtime
acceptance.given: A local operator configures a private state directory.
acceptance.when: Accept an offline request, restart the CLI, and resume with its run ID.
acceptance.then: The fresh process completes the saved request and status records one attempt.

acceptance.given: The private ledger contains a row written by the prototype worker integration.
acceptance.when: Read or resume the stored run through the offline entry point.
acceptance.then: The entry point refuses to read or advance it and preserves its bytes.

acceptance.given: The runtime configuration contains the prototype worker field.
acceptance.when: Invoke the entry point with the configuration.
acceptance.then: The entry point rejects the configuration before creating a state directory.

acceptance.given: An external specialist returns a different operation or claims execution authority.
acceptance.when: Submit the peer response to the offline runtime.
acceptance.then: The ledger rejects the response under its original delegation binding.

acceptance.given: All registered packages contribute to the feature inventory.
acceptance.when: Generate the central catalog and each plugin's operation metadata.
acceptance.then: Each package is represented and unsupported features stay labeled unsupported.

acceptance.given: An exported bundle sits outside the source checkout.
acceptance.when: Invoke its supplied-data SOC and assessment operations.
acceptance.then: The bundle executes the registered offline bindings from its own files.

acceptance.given: A harness can import the MCP entry point before installing the optional SDK.
acceptance.then: Discovery returns the available offline tools without requiring the SDK.

acceptance.given: A harness requests a removed worker operation.
acceptance.then: Invocation is blocked with an unknown operation error.

acceptance.given: An operator asks in ordinary language to review the bundled detections.
acceptance.when: Run the existing workspace request tool through the stdio harness.
acceptance.then: Routing selects the Detection Quality workbench and skill and reports gaps from both suites.

acceptance.given: The harness exits after recording the Sentinel suite receipt.
acceptance.when: Restart with the same chat run ID and replay after completion.
acceptance.then: The second process reuses Sentinel, evaluates Splunk once, and replay returns both saved receipts.

acceptance.given: A pull request is draft or ready and the three prerequisite jobs return terminal states.
acceptance.when: Run the validation step for every combination of readiness and job results.
acceptance.then: Only a ready PR with headless conformance, laboratory, and portability checks all successful proceeds to the full suite.
